_note: Escape endings. Every clip starts on images/hallway.jpg and is pinned to a generated destination plate as image_end, exactly like the monster event clips. The room-transition `common` in regen_config.json cannot be reused here: it says 'preserve exact architecture, empty environment', which fights a clip whose whole job is to leave the station.
_common_note: Two separate strings on purpose. The first attempt used one shared `common` carrying 'walk through an opening doorway', which Flux painted INTO the destination plate — every ending arrived at a view framed by a doorframe, so the clip stopped on the threshold instead of walking out. The still must describe only where you end up; the doorway belongs to the video alone.
stillCommon: realistic cinematic sci-fi concept photograph, vertical mobile portrait framing, awe and scale, hopeful, the view filling the entire frame edge to edge, already standing out in the open space, no doorway, no door frame, no hatch, no airlock frame, no interior corridor, no walls, no people, no readable text, no watermark
videoCommon: realistic cinematic sci-fi vertical mobile portrait shot, smooth forward camera walk through an opening doorway and all the way out into a vast bright space, the doorway passing out of frame behind the camera, awe and relief, hopeful ending, no people, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, no creature, professional atmospheric game footage
negative: person, face, body, creature, readable text, logo, watermark, cartoon, painting, melting architecture, collapsing room, explosion, gore, horror, menacing, darkness, tessellated pattern, repeating texture, mosaic tile, grid pattern, kaleidoscope, fractal artifact

endings.title: Cleared For Departure
endings.still: interior of a small clean two-seat shuttle cockpit, wide curved canopy filling the view, calm blue instrument glow on the consoles, open starfield and a distant blue planet beyond the glass, empty pilot seat, no people
endings.video: the camera moves down the dim central hallway to the sealed door at the end, the door slides open onto warm cabin light, the camera walks through into a small shuttle cockpit and settles facing the wide curved canopy, open stars and a distant blue planet ahead through the glass

endings.title: Away Clean
endings.still: view through the round viewport of a small escape pod looking back at a huge damaged orbital station drifting against black space, the station lit along one edge by a distant sun, calm quiet stars, no people
endings.video: the camera moves down the dim central hallway to the sealed door at the end, the door slides open onto the padded interior of a compact escape pod, the camera moves inside and turns to the round viewport as the station falls away behind, the damaged station shrinking against black space

endings.title: The Inside Of A Star
endings.still: the vast curved interior surface of a dyson sphere seen from inside, an impossibly huge structured landscape curving up and over the horizon on all sides, a small bright sun hanging at the centre, warm golden light across endless geometric terrain, immense scale, no people
endings.video: the camera moves down the dim central hallway to the sealed door at the end, the door slides open onto overwhelming golden light, the camera walks out onto a high platform inside a dyson sphere, the enormous curved inner surface rising up and over the horizon in every direction, a small sun burning at the centre

endings.title: Under The Rings
endings.still: exotic alien moonscape of pale blue-grey dust and low smooth ridges, an enormous ringed gas giant filling half the black sky above the horizon, soft rim light across the ground, still and silent, no people
endings.video: the camera moves down the dim central hallway to the sealed airlock at the end, the airlock opens onto soft blue light, the camera walks out onto the surface of an alien moon, pale dust underfoot, an enormous ringed gas giant rising across the whole black sky ahead

endings.title: The Long View
endings.still: vast curved observation window running the full height of a quiet empty deck, a huge ringed planet turning slowly beyond the glass, cool blue planetlight washing across the clean empty floor, calm and still, no people
endings.video: the camera moves down the dim central hallway to the sealed door at the end, the door slides open onto cool blue light, the camera walks out onto a vast quiet observation deck, a huge ringed planet turning slowly beyond the full-height curved window ahead

endings.title: Smaller Every Second
endings.still: wide view of an enormous ring-shaped orbital station seen from outside and below, lit windows in long rows along its curve, a blue-green planet turning behind it, deep black space and scattered stars, calm and vast, no people
endings.video: the camera moves down the dim central hallway to the sealed door at the end, the door slides open onto bright white light, the camera moves out through the airlock into open space and turns slowly, the enormous ring station falling away behind against a blue-green planet
